name: Northeast Gateway Pipeline Lateral

values.EndLocation: Northeast Gateway Deepwater LNG Port, Massachusetts Bay (off Gloucester)

researcher_notes: No existing GEM row for this lateral (checked the roster context for Northeast Gateway, HubLine, Gloucester; only the parent Algonquin system rows exist). An Oil and Gas Journal item from March 2007 says Algonquin Gas Transmission, a Spectra Energy affiliate, let a pipelay contract for 16 miles of 24 inch trunkline plus two 18 inch laterals for the Northeast Gateway port. Natural Gas Intelligence items say the Federal Energy Regulatory Commission certificated a 16 mile, 24 inch lateral linking the HubLine to the port, with up to 800,000 Dth per day, built for service in late 2007. 16 miles is about 25.7 km, only just above the 25 km floor, and the length is stated as a round figure. Current status is inferred from the port starting deliveries in December 2007; no current-operation source was opened, so status is medium. The two 18 inch laterals are not counted. Parent (Enbridge) left blank as no source was opened for it. Route is offshore; no official GIS checked, RouteType not staged. Do not confirm the exact length against the FERC order before applying if it could fall under 15.5 miles.
